newsitem.title: USA: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Conrail busy on fresh CSX bid.
newsitem.headline: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Conrail busy on fresh CSX bid.

text.p: Interest in Conrail Inc options rose Thursday after suitor CSX Corp sweetened its bid for Conrail by $870 million, or $16 per share.
But options traders said the activity suggested investors were playing the situation a month at a time, with few expectations that the deal would change much from here on out.

"Volatilities are pretty low, so they don't really think there's going to be much different," one trader said. He added that the options activity indicates investors do not think the buyout price will change much either.
In late trading, Conrail shares were up 1-7/8 at 100-7/8.
Early Thursday, CSX raised its friendly offer for Conrail and analysts said the new terms valued Conrail at about $104 per share.
That is still below the all-cash $110 per share offer on the table from Norfolk Southern Corp.
CSX's offer is a cash-and-stock deal.
"It's 50-50 Norfolk Southern or CSX" winning the battle for Conrail, according to the options activity, the trader said in Philadelphia.
Conrail has rejected Norfolk Southern's offer, contending that CSX is a better fit.
Among the options, the Conrail December 100, which expires on Friday, was most active, with more than 8,500 contracts changing hands.
The January 95 call traded nearly 3,500, the January 100 call traded 2,550 and the January 105 call traded about 1,930.
On the put side, the January 90 was most active, trading 4,245 contracts, followed by the January 100 with 3,180.
"It looks like they're rolling over Decembers into Januarys," said Michael Schwartz at Oppenheimer & Co. "They're playing it one month at a time."
The trader noted that the revised bid by CSX also included an extension of the tender offer to January 22 and a rescheduled special shareholder meeting, set for January 17 from December 23.
"Nothing's going to happen before the January expiration so that's a big change," he said. January options expire January 18.
